item.title: QCon San Francisco 2026: How to Kill the Code Review
item.description: Ankit Jain of Aviator told QCon San Francisco 2026 that line-by-line code review is already fading, since most review comments concern knowledge sharing rather than defects and over 75% of PRs merge without human review. (1 source: infoq)
